# Tide alerts

A tide alert tells a crew when the water passes a level. Alerts are set up in Harbor Field.

> **Caution:**
>
> An alert is checked only while the app is open.

## Create an alert

1. Tap **New alert** and type `2.5` as the level.

   The alert appears in the list.
2. Choose the gauge.

![The alert list](https://help.example.com/en/harbor-field/alerts/GUID-9-web.png)

### Alert properties

**Alert properties**

_Property / Description_

**`level`**

The water level in metres.

**`direction`**

When the alert fires:

- rising
- falling

## Delete an alert

Swipe the alert to the left. See [Create an alert](https://help.example.com/en/harbor-field/alerts/tide-alerts.htm#ESRI_SECTION1_A1B2C3D4) to add it again.

> **Note:**
>
> Deleted alerts cannot be restored.
